subroutines.name: default_start
subroutines.title: *DEFAULT: restore a level file
subroutines.description: Disable ESCAPE, clear the screen, ask which level to reset and read one or two digits. Accept 1-25, copy that level's original (still encrypted) from the copies at &12B0 to &6B00 and *SAVE it as LevelN. Then offer another level, or quit through the reset vector. Level 25 is accepted and saved as Level25, although the game reads level 25 from Stones; and a leading zero (05) is kept in the filename (Level05), which the game does not read either.

banners.name: source_leftovers
banners.title: Leftovers: the end of the assembler source
banners.description: Never used. The rest of the tokenised BBC BASIC program that assembled *DEFAULT, as it lay in memory when the file was saved: the end of one line, then lines 1150-1370, with the levels' copies written over its last bytes. Its labels name this program's variables: store is level_digits, read and put are read_ptr and put_ptr, save is save_command and again is another_question. Each line is shown below as it reads when listed.

banners.name: level_1_original
banners.title: The original levels
banners.description: Levels 1 to 25 as the game loads them: &2B0 bytes each, encrypted (each byte XORed with the low byte of its address at &6B00). They are byte for byte the Model B side's Level1-Level24 and the end of Stones, except level 6, which is the cassette's (see findings.md). *DEFAULT finds level N at &1000 + N x &2B0.

items.comment_inline: OSBYTE &C8 with X=1, Y=0: disable ESCAPE...
OSBYTE &0F: flush buffers (X is the old &C8 setting, normally 0: all)
Print the prompt, up to and including its zero...
...and fill it in: the buffer is level_digits...
... Read line from input stream (exits with C=1 if ESCAPE pressed)
One digit: blank the second, for the filename...
...plus &2B0 for each level: level N's copy...
Put the digits into the SAVE command
Print the question, up to and including its zero
OSBYTE &0F: flush the input buffer (X is non-zero)
Yes: quit through the reset vector
